summary_1line: Vibhandaka warns Rishyasringa about seductive Rakshasas, but courtesans lure him to Anga, bringing rain; his father later reconciles after seeing his son settled.

image_candidates.scene_text: Courtesans coax the naive sage Rishyasringa onto a white floating vessel as he eagerly follows them before his father returns.
Dark clouds break and heavy rain pours over the kingdom of Anga the moment Rishyasringa arrives at the palace.
The furious sage Vibhandaka strides toward the city to destroy it but pauses among rich cattle fields prepared in his son's name.
